display_long_description:
A quiet harbor town holds more secrets than you might imagine.

Step into the role of an FBI agent and explore the world of Maze of Thorns. From the waterfront to the grounds of the Primm estate, search detailed scenes, collect intriguing objects, and piece together clues as your investigation unfolds.

Every discovery brings you closer to the truth. Find unexpected uses for everyday items, unlock new locations, and work your way through a variety of puzzles at your own pace.

Features:
• A complete single-player mystery adventure.
• Detailed artwork and an atmospheric soundtrack.
• A world filled with objects to discover and puzzles to solve.
• An in-game map to help you find your way.
• Built-in hints when you need a little guidance.
• Save your progress and return to your investigation later.

Made by Fire Maple Games.

This is a traditional 2D point-and-click adventure played on a floating screen in your Meta Quest headset.
